runtimeProtocol.inputParity: Compare all 32 tensor hashes between the two native arms; no browser parity inferred.

pipeline.selection: Keep every production crop. Only if none exists, accept an outline-supported neural proposal with observed rectified overlap >=99% and maximum axis-normalized extrapolation <=5%, always needs_review. Use analytic projective coverage; no mask score or template selects the crop.
pipeline.fits: Same fixed native model, source photos, support gates, production controls and 10-second solver. Only construct the existing weighted colour fields directly, without requiring the threshold palette to succeed first. Fresh fits for every selected neural crop; no per-case method selection.
pipeline.validation: Independent exported weave error <=3%, original feature checks, geometry/paper checks, production editable conversion and independent editable-paper audit. Visual review of all photos/crops and distinct outputs.
pipeline.missing: No manual rescue or result-dependent replacement. Record photo eligibility misclassifications and possible irregular weaving separately without removing them from primary denominators.

scope: Fixed-budget supervision comparison. Both arms are newly trained from the same pretrained U2NETP initialization. No crop, palette, fitter, loss or acceptance-threshold tuning per photo. All added source groups already occur in training; the 32 evaluation photos remain source/duplicate separated. Native control reconstruction. Separate follow-up isolates the redundant threshold-palette gate; original pre-fix results remain unchanged.
